title: Tighter sign-in and a steadier week

blocks.text: Three releases shipped this week, and none of them asks you to change how you work. The loudest change is at the front door: admin sign-in now wants a second factor before it hands out a session.

items: Tighter sign-in checks — admins confirm a second factor at sign-in, session cookies now slide forward on activity instead of expiring mid-afternoon, and the legacy token endpoint is gone (Authentication).
Add tasks module — the task list reached its first stable shape, and the spec picked up its happy-path scenarios (Tasks).
Trim scenario titles — titles no longer carry stray whitespace into spec rows and exports (Tasks).

blocks.text: The spec and the product map already reflect everything above, so there is nothing to migrate. If you read one thing, make it the second-factor note and pass it to support — they will hear about it first.
